title: A mailbox-woken turn that fails at the provider (crash, runtime error, revoked token) pauses the queue until a manual Resume; retry it automatically on the common recovery schedule, with a bound
outcome: When a turn woken by a mailbox notification fails after delivery, the restored wake is retried automatically on the common recovery schedule (the delays, jitter, tick, per-head guard and host-wide cap that w-7224e6317e55 extracted), so a transient provider failure needs no Resume. After a bounded number of consecutive failures of the same head, the queue holds as it does today. That hold says it is a repeated provider failure and names the head and its last error. The sender's disposition names the hold instead of queuedBehindActiveTurn.
acceptance: A mailbox-woken turn that fails at the provider (crash, runtime error, revoked token) pauses the queue until a manual Resume; retry it automatically on the common recovery schedule, with a bound is done
